follow-up time: The duration of the study was 2 years.
exposure: Baseline systolic blood pressure (SBP) <120 mm Hg
outcome: Heart rate during caesarean section and after admission to IMC
Fetal arterial cord pH and base excess levels
cohort: 852 obstetric patients scheduled for caesarean section (440 Akrinor, 412 phenylephrine).
finding: Phenylephrine was not superior to Akrinor for treating spinal anaesthesia-induced maternal hypotension during caesarean section.
